brief.intent: RambleDesk desktop app Gate 1 direction A, Archive Command: design a complete cross-platform Windows, macOS, and Linux main window as a calm, precise, trustworthy Vault Zero archive command center. It must be an implementable desktop product UI, never a website poster.
brief.audience: Developers and creators who continuously narrate, capture screenshots, import context, edit, and submit structured feedback to an Agent while using other software.
brief.emotionalGoal: A quiet, precise, always-ready archive center maintained by the chief military secretary; information-dense without feeling oppressive.
brief.composition: 1536 by 1024 landscape desktop app. A draggable custom app titlebar with cross-platform window controls; a roughly 260px request queue on the left; task instructions and a large Markdown rich-document flow in the center; a narrow status rail on the right for Ramble, attachments, save, and submission. Rambelle appears only as a low-distraction bust or assistant in an empty state or status rail.
mustInclude: Custom desktop titlebar with RambleDesk identity, current project, connection state, settings, Windows/Linux controls, and safe space for macOS traffic lights
Left pending/history request queue showing project, Agent, state, and update time
Central task summary, test steps, context references, and directly editable rich-text feedback document
Prominent but restrained Start Ramble action plus live recording, screenshot, attachment, and save state feedback
Submit feedback and Open Feedback Package completed state
New hexagonal vault-door emblem, ice-blue line grid, transparent archive slate, and sparse amber warning accents
avoid: Browser frame, landing page, marketing poster composition
Old circular zero emblem or eye-like symbol
Dark cyberpunk, glitch, or retro print styling
Baking real controls, text, or headings into decorative illustration
Code symbols, dense neon, or heavy skeuomorphism
creativeFreedom: Rambelle pose and scale in empty states

acceptanceCriteria: Reads instantly as a mature desktop productivity app, not a site or poster
Maps visibly to the complete existing RambleDesk workflow
Custom titlebar is cross-platform and has clear drag and control regions
Character and pattern support the workspace without blocking it
Uses only the new hexagonal vault emblem and no code symbols
notes: RepoChan Web Designer Gate 1 visual direction A. All L4 controls and text remain live in implementation; master image is only the visual reference.
